## Activity

During December 2024, Hill Counties Health Centre completed 108 captures. Activity was delivered through the planned clinic sessions, with session lists running as planned apart from routine leave. The number of captures provides the basis for reviewing image quality and grading outcomes for the month.

## Image quality

Of the 108 captures, 8 were ungradable. This represents an ungradable rate of 7.4. The ungradable images should be considered when reviewing the overall quality of the screening activity. The result indicates that most captures were suitable for grading, while a smaller proportion could not be assessed.

## Grading

A total of 20 results were graded referable. The median grading lag was 9. This measure records the typical interval before grading was completed and provides an indicator of the timeliness of the grading process. Overall, the December 2024 activity shows completed capture activity, with image quality and grading outcomes recorded for routine operational monitoring.
